LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public, non-PII player ranking record showing badge count, fastest mission completion time, stars, and mission count.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Public player nickname shown on the leaderboard.

fastestMissionMs.description: Fastest mission completion duration in milliseconds (0 if not yet timed).

fastestLevelTitle.description: Title of the mission completed in fastest time.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when leaderboard entry was last updated.

UserProfileProgress.title: UserProfileProgress
UserProfileProgress.description: Private user cloud save containing account metadata, completed levels, unlocked badges, and gameplay stats.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

unlockedZones.description: List of unlocked zone IDs (max 10 items).

unlockedBadges.description: Map of badgeId -> ISO timestamp string.

stats.description: Gameplay metrics including fastDebugSolves, totalPerfectRuns, fastestMissionMs, fastestLevelTitle.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last cloud save.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Public non-PII leaderboard records indexed by Firebase Auth userId.

/users/{userId}.description: Private cloud backup of user progress, badges, and PII strictly accessible only to the owning user.
